resources.string: Animated dots at the edges of the screen move with the car\'s acceleration, braking and turns. Matching what your eyes see to what your body feels can reduce motion sickness when reading or watching in a moving vehicle.
Motion cues are drawn on top of whatever app you\'re using. Android needs your permission for that.
Turn on \"Allow display over other apps\" for Vehicle Motion Cues, then come back.
Couldn\'t start motion cues. Open the app and try again.
Regular dots are always visible. Dynamic dots fade in only while the vehicle is speeding up, slowing down or turning.
Tip: add the \"Motion cues\" tile to Quick Settings to turn this on with one tap when you get in the car.
Dots move with the vehicle to ease motion sickness
